title.en: Which printed window fits this check: when does infrastructure use HBT8018
title.zh: 这一问只对一个窗口：基建什么时候用 HBT8018

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. When the job matches the HBT8018 cells, not the 900 m Electric 80 cells. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S for high-output trailer pumping, infrastructure and high-rise pours, and jobs listed at 60 m³/h. Taken from the printed row: The table is 132 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, conveying distance 150 m, delivery height 450 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg.
description.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。工况对得上 HBT8018 的格子，而不是电动80的 900 m。邢台河北品锦机械把 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S 列为大排量拖式泵送、基建与高层浇筑，以及目录 60 m³/h 的工程。表是 132 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm、6500 kg。

heading.en: Reynolds Number for Flow in Pipe or Duct

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Reynolds Number for Flow in Pipe or Duct” from “Laminar vs. Turbulent Flow - Reynolds Number Explained with Calculator”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. HBT8018 prints 132 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, conveying 150 m, delivery height 450 m and aggregate 4 cm and below, for infrastructure and high-rise pours. Keep this cell as published. The table is 132 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, conveying distance 150 m, delivery height 450 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg. Taken from the printed row: Aggregate is wider here (4 cm and below) than Electric 80’s 2 cm limit. Read it in the Xingtai table. LZ-80 prints up to 95 m³/h in the low-pressure mode and aggregate 6 cm and below. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Say whether the limiting number is 150 m conveying, 450 m height, 4 cm stone or the 132 kW supply. Keep this cell as published. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Taken from the printed row: Electric 80 and HBT80-16 print HBT80-1816-110. Read it in the Xingtai table. Keep the page you opened. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/reynolds-number-d_237.html
body.zh: 本节保留《Laminar vs. Turbulent Flow - Reynolds Number Explained with Calculator》的标题“雷诺数流量管道”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。HBT8018 印了 132 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、输送 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下，用于基建与高层浇筑。这一格照已印出的读：柴油120印的是 100 m³/h、150 m / 500 m、双机 145 kW 柴油机。LZ-80 在低压模式印到 95 m³/h，骨料 6 cm 及以下。基建现场供不起 132 kW 时用那两台。HBT8018 不会因为改口燃料就变成柴油泵。目录里已经写着：不是。HBT8018 印的是 HBT8018-132S。电动80和 HBT80-16 印的是 HBT80-1816-110。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/reynolds-number-d_237.html

body.en: The section shape comes from “Example - Calculate Reynolds Number” in “Laminar vs. Turbulent Flow - Reynolds Number Explained with Calculator”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. When the job matches the HBT8018 cells, not the 900 m Electric 80 cells. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Do not swap them, and do not call 150 m the same as Electric 80’s 900 m horizontal. Keep this cell as published. The motor is 132 kW, so this is still a grid-powered trailer pump. Taken from the printed row: Use those when the infrastructure site cannot feed 132 kW. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Keep this cell as published. On Electric 80 the aggregate cell is ≤ 2 cm. Taken from the printed row: No.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Laminar vs. Turbulent Flow - Reynolds Number Explained with Calculator》的“例子计算雷诺数”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：工况对得上 HBT8018 的格子，而不是电动80的 900 m。邢台河北品锦机械把 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S 列为大排量拖式泵送、基建与高层浇筑，以及目录 60 m³/h 的工程。表是 132 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm、6500 kg。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请说明限制你的是输送 150 m、高度 450 m、4 cm 石子，还是 132 kW 电源。这一格照已印出的读：在电动80上骨料格是 ≤ 2 cm。在 HBT8018 上是 4 cm 及以下。停在你打开的那一页。

body.en: “Laminar vs. Turbulent Flow - Reynolds Number Explained with Calculator” breaks its subject at “Online Reynolds Calculator”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S for high-output trailer pumping, infrastructure and high-rise pours, and jobs listed at 60 m³/h. Read it in the Xingtai table. Both pages print 60 m³/h and 40 MPa. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h, 150 m / 500 m and twin 145 kW diesels. Keep this cell as published. HBT8018 does not become a diesel pump by changing the fuel story. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. HBT8018 prints HBT8018-132S. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. On HBT8018 it is 4 cm and below. Keep this cell as published. Send metres, stone and power. Headings already printed: 150 m is conveying distance, 450 m is height
body.zh: 《Laminar vs. Turbulent Flow - Reynolds Number Explained with Calculator》在“在线雷诺计算器”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。目录里已经写着：不要把它们对调，也不要把 150 m 说成电动80的水平 900 m。两页都印 60 m³/h 和 40 MPa。这里的骨料更宽（4 cm 及以下），电动80限在 2 cm。电机是 132 kW，所以它仍是有电网的拖泵。按邢台表上的原文理解：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。旁边那一台不在这句话里。不必须。发送米数、石子和动力即可。已印出的标题：150 米是输送距离，450 米是高度

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Reynolds Number for Flow in Pipe or Duct” — Is HBT8018 the same code as Electric 80?
question.zh: “雷诺数流量管道”旁边仍要印着的是什么：HBT8018 和电动80是同一个代号吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. HBT8018 prints HBT8018-132S. Electric 80 and HBT80-16 print HBT80-1816-110.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。不是。HBT8018 印的是 HBT8018-132S。电动80和 HBT80-16 印的是 HBT80-1816-110。

question.en: “Example - Calculate Reynolds Number” does not change the check: Does 60 m³/h require 2 cm stone?
question.zh: “例子计算雷诺数”不改这一问：60 m³/h 必须是 2 cm 石子吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. On Electric 80 the aggregate cell is ≤ 2 cm. On HBT8018 it is 4 cm and below. Keep the page you opened.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：在电动80上骨料格是 ≤ 2 cm。在 HBT8018 上是 4 cm 及以下。停在你打开的那一页。

question.en: Is a project name required, once the outline says “Online Reynolds Calculator”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“在线雷诺计算器”时，必须有项目名称吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No. Send metres, stone and power.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：不必须。发送米数、石子和动力即可。
